<thought>Using the molecular formula C18H13O2, the double bond equivalent (DBE) is calculated by the formula DBE = (2C + 2 - H)/2, ignoring O. Substituting the values gives DBE = (2*18 + 2 - 13)/2 = (36 + 2 - 13)/2 = 25/2 = 12.5, which rounds to the nearest integer 13.</thought>
<final_answer>13</final_answer>
